The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the problem of automatic layout selection, a simple, greedy algorithm (e.g., epsilon-greedy, upper confidence bound, and Thompson sampling) is sufficient to outperform the state-of-the-art.
the performance of bandit algorithms on real-world problems is highly dependent on the choice of exploration function.
